address: Tiong Bahru Market, #02-29, 30 Seng Poh Road, 168898, Singapore
bio: Pork offal like tripe and liver is served with meatballs and sliced pork in a peppery broth with pickled mustard greens. Dip the pork into chilli sauce for an extra kick. Also try the sticky rice sausage stuffed with pork belly and chestnuts....
